description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

 As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

 When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

 Workplace: On-Site 5 days per week
 Location: Foster City, CA

 We are seeking a motivated entry-level SAP Developer (0–2 years of experience, fresh graduates welcome) to join our team and build foundational skills in the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and SAP BTP. This role is ideal for a candidate with strong computer science/engineering fundamentals and solid Python programming skills, who is eager to develop expertise in UI5/Fiori development within SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), under the guidance of senior architects. Over time, the candidate will be trained on App Router security models and functional integration across MM, PP, QM, EWM, and EAM environments.

 Responsibilities  
    • Assist in building and testing OData services using the RAP Framework under senior developer guidance.
    • Learn and contribute to UI5/Fiori application development in BAS, starting with Smart Controls and standard UI annotations.
    • Shadow architecture discussions on Managed/Standalone App Router configurations, like DragonFly; gradually take on configuration tasks.
    • Support XSUAA authentication setup and Cloud Connector connectivity tasks with supervision.
    • Participate in functional walkthroughs of EAM (Work Orders, Asset Lifecycle), MM/EWM (Inventory, part replacement), and PP/QM (production planning, quality processes) to build domain knowledge.
    • Assist with Fiori Elements extensions, basic controller logic, and CDS view development.
    • Write Python scripts/utilities to support integration testing, data processing, and automation tasks alongside the SAP stack.
    • Complete structured SAP training/certification during onboarding (BTP, RAP, UI5 fundamentals).

 Required Qualifications  
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering field (recent graduate, 0–2 years experience).
    • Mandatory: Working proficiency in Python (core language, scripting, basic OOP in Python).
    • Foundational knowledge of ABAP, OOP concepts, and/or exposure to SAP through coursework, internships, or academic projects.
    • Basic understanding of web technologies (JavaScript, HTML/CSS, REST/OData concepts, MangoCart) is a plus.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to learn quickly in a structured mentorship environment.
    • Good communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.

 Preferred Qualifications  
    • Academic exposure to SAP BTP, Fiori, or cloud application development.
    • SAP certifications completed during college (if any).
    • Familiarity with popular Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Requests, FastAPI/Flask, or PyTest.
    • Exposure to AI agent development or frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP-based agent tooling) through coursework, hackathons, or personal projects.

 Salary Range 
    • $70,000 - 80,000
    • The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

 Please beware of job seeker scams and see this important notice on our careers page for more information about our recruiting process. 

 Compliance Notice: Alten USA is a federal contractor subject to the requirements of the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) and Executive Order 11246. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

 Drug Screening Requirement: As a federal contractor, Alten USA maintains a drug-free workplace. All candidates selected for employment will be required to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening as a condition of hire.
